name: Solidly V3
description: Self-optimizing DEX combining the best of Curve, Uniswap and ve(3,3)

methodology.UserFees: User pays fees on each swap.
methodology.Revenue: 20% of the fees are distributed to voters using veSOLID.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 80% of the fees are distributed to liquidity providers, along with emissions of the SOLID token.
